notes: Bernal Heights / Mission-Alemany ground: irregular blocks on several street grids, and five fills meeting (diagonal stripes, fine cross-hatch, coarse grid, solid black, white), several blocks holding two fills. First tried at x0=1480,y0=560; moved west because east of x about 1980 railway tracks run across the streets and join the blocks (Patterson St). HOW DRAWN: one seed per printed block; strokes on printed lines shared by blocks or with gaps; limits only to cut street marks that bridge two blocks (no line printed there). (a) Blocks 5379 (Conkling), the striped strip '336' and 5380 share one bent line (1128,1011)-(1067,1041)-(1045,1104)-(1021,1170): stroke along it, run up through the north line into the street and down to (1018,1190); a short stroke (1011,1196)-(1018,1204) cuts the junction where the strip's tip, that line and the small triangle below (991-1014, 1200-1223) meet. (b) 5368 (wedge) and 5390 share the segment (1292,936)-(1316,918): stroke (1285,942)-(1322,912). (c) 5335 shares its south line (948,1570)-(1127,1519) with two striped blocks: stroke along it, through the junction with 5335's NE line. (d) Gaps closed by strokes: two small triangles' apex corners ((1447,775)-(1445,764), (1449,912)-(1453,905)); two coarse-grid block outlines ((1844,1351)-(1831,1367), (1840,1574)-(1850,1581)). (e) Limits: ditto marks bridging two blocks at (1691,988)-(1691,1006) and (1779,1041)-(1797,1041); the A of HELENA hanging into the street below block 5378, (1165,788)-(1190,788). (f) Street paper cut off by the box (above Boutwell, x 950-1090, y 600-680) and Conkling St (dead-ends at line (a)) got street seeds (980,620), (1000,1095). FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) 5335 (white land west of the long diagonal, 950-1129 x 1179-1567, block number 5335 at about 1010,1470; Holly Park?) marked as a block: its NE side is its own line, its west side is off the box. It may be meant as a park/open land. (2) Three small closed triangles at junctions, (1449,778), (1452,925), (1003,1210), marked as blocks; they may be traffic islands (street). (3) The narrow paper channel (about 12 px) between the REVERE/5587 block and the block at 1700-1830 x 960-1050, closed at both ends by those blocks' corners and marks, read as a street (seed 1745,1037). (4) The SELBY name frame (1640-1765, 1420-1500) is joined to block 5585 and labelled as part of it; it may be a name box in the street. (5) Read as ONE block each (no street line between): white 5596 with the cross-hatched HIGHWAY band; the Waterloo block (fine cross-hatch and coarse grid, LOOMIS ST lettered inside its south edge); Barneveld block with the Swan strip; 5311 and 5318 with their black parts; the black/cross-hatch block at 1480-1640 x 1330-1580 with its white NW corner. (6) Left as is: a few px of lettering still attached to blocks (RANKIN's last letters at about 1433,1538; PAYTON under 5380 at about 990,1183), and a small mark on Marengo block's south vertex (about 1525,760). Unseeded islands left as street are ditto and dimension marks (under 120 px).
